title: All 15 Webots integration scenarios passed
summary: This CI run tested the merged PR #169 (harden dev Webots runner isolation) on the dev branch. All 15 scenarios across builtin, cap, and flow families passed with a 100% pass rate. The changes include concurrency group locking, GPU capacity waiting, RUN_KEY-based isolation, voiceprint CPU device, and improved map persistence verification.
pr_changes: Added concurrency group and cancel-in-progress: false to gpu_testing job
Added RUN_ATTEMPT and RUN_KEY environment variables for per-run isolation
Added ROBONIX_CI_MIN_GPU_FREE_MIB variable and a step to wait for GPU capacity
Set VOICEPRINT_DEVICE=cpu to keep ECAPA verification off the GPU
Replaced RUN_ID with RUN_KEY in container names, runtime directories, and map IDs
Removed hardcoded ROBONIX_SIM_CONTAINER env overrides in restart and capture steps
Added a dedicated step to clean the runner-local run directory after the job
Updated testing/README.md to document new map persistence checks
Enhanced testing/simulate_ci.py to handle regex assertions and synthetic text generation
Enhanced testing/verify_scene_map_persistence.py to check fresh occupancy and report dimension differences as warnings
test_result: Webots CI exercised 15 scenarios (4 builtin, 8 cap, 3 flow) covering file operations, plan control, camera/lidar snapshots, explore, mapping, memory, scene, speech, voiceprint, fault recovery, object navigation, and patrol observe. All passed. The map persistence verification (scene-map-persistence.txt) passed 16/16 checks including fresh occupancy and dimension matching.
suggested_fix: No fix needed. Monitor the new GPU capacity waiting step for timeout issues on busy runners. Watch for any regressions in map dimension reporting due to the new diagnostic warnings.
risks_or_watchouts: The new GPU capacity waiting step may timeout if the runner GPU is persistently busy
The map persistence script now reports dimension differences as WARN instead of FAIL; ensure this does not mask real regressions
The voiceprint CPU device change may affect performance of enrollment/identification in CI
